name: ironai
description: IronAI — AI-powered workout & diet coach. Full-stack fitness app.

scripts.db:up: docker compose up -d postgres && node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process');const cmd=['docker','compose','exec','-T','postgres','pg_isready','-U','ironai','-d','ironai'];for(let i=0;i<40;i++){try{execSync(cmd.join(' '),{stdio:'ignore'});console.log('✅ 本地 PostgreSQL 已就绪 (localhost:5432, user=ironai, db=ironai)');process.exit(0);}catch(e){}console.log('等待 PostgreSQL 就绪... '+(i+1)+'/40');Atomics.wait(new Int32Array(new SharedArrayBuffer(4)),0,0,1000);}console.error('❌ PostgreSQL 启动超时');process.exit(2);"
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && echo '已删除本地数据卷' && pnpm db:up
